statements.t: “Following top-line results from our Phase 2 MoMeNtum trial of claseprubart in December, we plan to quickly initiate a Phase 3 trial in MMN in 2027.

dropped.t: “With the initiation of our Phase 3 EMERGE registrational trial in gMG, excellent interim results from Part A of our Phase 3 CAPTIVATE trial in CIDP, and completion of enrollment in the Phase 2 MoMeNtum trial in MMN with top-line results expected in December, claseprubart continues to demonstrate its potential as a best-in-disease, pipeline-in-a-product opportunity.
In addition, we anticipate Phase 1 healthy volunteer data for DNTH212 by year end.
